action.subsystem: Razer Laptop Cooling Pad fan control
action.name: Fixed 2200 to Auto vendor-oracle transition

validation.applyResult: Confirmed successfully: the operator selected Fixed RPM 2200 in Synapse and held it for at least five seconds.
validation.readbackResult: Confirmed: Synapse continued to display Fixed RPM 2200; USB traffic contained one status-02 acknowledgement echoing the exact Fixed payload. No active-mode or current-speed getter was issued.
validation.restorationResult: The operator restored the cooling pad to Auto in Synapse and held it for at least five seconds.
validation.restorationReadbackResult: Confirmed restored: Synapse displayed Auto; USB traffic contained one status-02 acknowledgement echoing the exact Auto payload. USBPcap stopped gracefully and OpenBlade remained stopped.

sanitizedEvidence.summary: Synapse issued one Fixed 2200 request and received a status-02 response echoing the exact semantic payload.
Synapse issued one Auto restoration request and received a status-02 response echoing the exact semantic payload.
The vendor transition emitted no 0D/81, 0D/88, or 0D/90 getter, so its UI confirmation is not independent device readback.

limitations: The status-02 responses echo semantic payloads but do not prove physical fan speed, active mode, ownership, or persistence.

The earlier OpenBlade trial used the same Fixed and Auto semantic payloads but failed configured-target validation and later required a complete pad power cycle after Synapse reported sleep mode with flashing red lighting.

This vendor-oracle capture therefore confirms command encoding only. It does not admit an OpenBlade fan write or remove the need for initialization, active-mode readback, physical confirmation, and reversible cleanup evidence.
USB device addresses are transient and are not production identity evidence.

Multi-device correlation is limited: the two selected devices shared one USB root, but this capture uses only explicitly marked cooling-pad transactions and does not infer cross-device timing or causality.
The raw PCAP, decoded transactions, and operator markers remain local and uncommitted.
notes: OpenBlade service, Tray, and Session Agent were stopped before capture and were intentionally left stopped afterward at the operator's request.
Two preceding captures selected stale post-reboot USBPcap addresses and contained only a PCAP header; they are not evidence and are not referenced here.
A passive all-device root probe established the live post-reboot USBPcap addresses before this successful bounded capture.
